sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate preserves the required ship target, PC6/PC7 applicability, and the explicit alternative structure: verticalSidedBowForm true OR at least one normalFrameAngle QuantityValue with decimal numericValue in the inclusive 0–10 degree range. It also retains owner-correct datatype/cardinality constraints for bowDesignForceMethod and bowVerticalSideStatus without inventing values. Deterministic validation is valid and no canonical vocabulary repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability logic: the requirement covers PC6/PC7 ships with vertical-sided bows and also includes bows whose considered-subregion normal frame angles are between 0 and 10 degrees. Do not require vertical-sided-bow evidence and at least one valid angle simultaneously; encode the applicable alternatives explicitly, while ensuring that any represented normalFrameAngle is a decimal QuantityValue in unit:DEG with an inclusive 0–10 range and that missing angle evidence cannot satisfy the angle alternative. Preserve the ship target and supplied canonical terms.

Preserve the corrected applicability as Polar Class PC6/PC7 AND (vertical-sided bow OR a represented normalFrameAngle in unit:DEG with decimal value 0–10 inclusive). However, the COMPLETE dependency contract declares bowDesignForceMethod and bowVerticalSideStatus as directConstraintTerms, and the candidate omits both; add owner-correct ship-level constraints for those supplied canonical terms without inventing values. Ensure the angle constraint reflects the considered-subregion angle relationship rather than imposing an unjustified maxCount 1 on the ship-level normalFrameAngle property.

The candidate preserves the required ship target, PC6/PC7 applicability, and the explicit alternative structure: verticalSidedBowForm true OR at least one normalFrameAngle QuantityValue with decimal numericValue in the inclusive 0–10 degree range. It also retains owner-correct datatype/cardinality constraints for bowDesignForceMethod and bowVerticalSideStatus without inventing values. Deterministic validation is valid and no canonical vocabulary repair is required.
